about: Cases for the caption text helpers, read by both OzenKitTests (CaptionTextSharedCasesTests, Swift) and core CaptionTextSharedCasesTest (Kotlin). phoneNumbers: PhoneNumbers.matches(input) as [shown text, dialable] pairs. readableText, copiedText: CaptionLayout's functions of that name. displayText, directed, readsRightToLeft: CaptionLayout's functions, expected per language code (languages that give the same answer share a key, "he,ar"). uncertainSpoken: UncertainWords.spoken(input, words); uncertainRanges: the text of each UncertainWords.ranges(input, words). Invisible direction marks are written as \u escapes. The expected answers were written from the Swift side and checked by the Kotlin one.

cases.input: Good morning, how did you sleep?
I can take you, no problem.
אני הולך לבית ספר ואחר כך לחנות ואחר כך הביתה כי מאוחר ויש לי עוד הרבה עבודה לעשות לפני שאני הולך לישון הלילה
